name: agentdust
description: Explain AgentDust reports and local setup.

interface.longDescription: Explain AgentDust process and disk reports that users provide, and guide local setup. This skills package does not connect to a Mac or provide live process access. Live inspection requires a separately configured local AgentDust MCP connection. Cleanup requires AgentDust's own typed approval.
defaultPrompt: Help me understand this AgentDust disk report:
How do I set up AgentDust locally?

publication.release_notes: Initial skills-only package for AgentDust 0.3.0 beta. Provides local process review and disk report guidance without a hosted process-control service.
